ar: رَبَّنَآ أٰتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَّفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَّقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ ۝۲۰۱
tr: Rabbanā ātinā fi ‘d-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fi ‘l-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā `adhāba ‘n-Nār.
en: Our Lord, grant us good in this life, good in the next and save us from the torment of the fire .

ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوْبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَ هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ رَحْمَةًۚ إِنَّكَ اَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ ۝۸
tr: Rabbanā lā tuzigh qulūbanā ba`da idh hadaytanā, wa hab lanā min ladunka raḥmatan innaka anta ‘l-Wahhāb.
en: Our Lord, do not let our hearts waiver after You have guided us and bestow upon us Mercy from Your Self, surely You are the Bestower!

ar: إِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَمَلٓئِكَتَهٗ يُصَلُّوْنَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّؕ يآأَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ أٰمَنُوْا صَلُّوْا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوْا تَسْلِيْمًا ۝۵۶
tr: Inna ‘lLāha wa Malā’ikatahū yuṣallūna ala ‘n-Nabiyyi, Yā Ayyuha ‘lladhīna āmanū ṣallū alayhi wa sallimū taslīmā.
en: Allah and His Angels surely send prayers upon the Prophet; O you who believe, send prayers upon him and salute him most thoroughly!
blocks.review: وَمَلٓئِكَتَهٗ: only one tall stroke (lām) with a madda over it, no separate alif or visible dagger alif; hamza seat drawn with hamza+kasra below. النَّبِيِّ: kasra under the final yā partly cut off at the crop edge. يآأَيُّهَا: yā + alif-madda + أَ, no dagger alif, transcribed as seen.
